competences.description: Attacks the enemy and creates a shield equal to 10% of your MAX HP on the ally with the lowest HP status for 2 turns. In addition, Sapsaree attacks the enemy and stuns for 1 turn with a 50% chance if you gain a turn while under inability effects.

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
effets.note: 10% on ally with the lowest HP status

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: If you gain a turn while under inability effects

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times to decrease their Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Increases the Attack Bar of the allies under inability effects by 30% at the start of your turn. In addition, you gain immunity to Attack Bar decreasing effects while under inability effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
Immune to Attack Bar decreasing effects
